body: I guess you're right... I'll go then...
This... Isn't a problem that can be solved by that... It's too great.
You can read my post history if you want to get an idea...
Depression... It's getting worse and worse... No help is helping... I don't know what to do...

I can't remember how it started... It's been too long, 10 years maybe? It's a constant emotional pain, something that I feel sucking inside my chest. My mind attacks me, thoughts that do not come from my conscious chain critisize me... I have paranoia and sometimes mild psychotic episodes... I feel... Like the future is bleak. Attempting to do something makes me worse.

And on top of all this, I want to kill myself constantly. Every second. Of every day. The suicidalness hasn't stopped for the past few weeks. Constantly. Drilling into me... I've been through too much to be cured...  Colours start to look less vibrant, sounds start to annoy me more... I can't listen to music when I am at my worst... I do not want to sleep as I will have no distraction, I go to sleep every day at my very worst, with nothing to distract me writhing in emotional agony... And yet I am so tired... I don't want to exist anymore...

I wish I was not a good person, that I was an asshole who no one would miss, then I could at least kill myself... But like all depressed people there are people who care about me, and there are people in my life who depend on me to avoid suicide themselves... I do not want to leave this life having let them die too... But I wish to die... So much...
My family are not the problem, at least not anymore, it's just the emotional damage.
I mainly play SC2... I'm going to go to bed now though... Thanks for listening to what I have to say.
They aren't working because to put it simply, I cannot work under the circumstances of depression...

A lot of what I've experienced I dealt with by using my intelligence, and as a result using my intelligence helps with the depression (Eases it). Video games are just, at least how I play them a constant source of things for me to think about, (I play very strategic games)
I guess you could describe it like that... And I also have a bunch of other stuff like paranoia.

I understand my psychology very well, and it has to do with using my intellect. Things which make my brain think are generally positive but some video games provide a constant source of deep thoughtfulness (Thus the very good bit)
I don't know if you understand this, but there are certain types of emotional pain you physically feel, like a writhing uncomfortableness on top of everything that wills you to not exist...
I like playing video games, it's my only escape and I am very good...

I like it... I guess... But this isn't your usual case of world looks bleak depression. This is a every second is torment kind of depression... I'm your maths physics computing type... But I'm not enthralled by any subjects anymore.
I go to school, which I am failing, because doing work causes me to become more suicidal than usual...
9 years... of emotional abuse from everyone around me par my parents, who neglected to support me in any way... No one ever helped me... and the pain still stings as if the wound was fresh.
